name: The Dragon's Equation
source:
Having abandoned her dream, the protagonist spends her days as a university student majoring in astrophysics.
One day, she encounters a young man who claims to be a dragon, and her destiny begins to change.

[From [url=https://kinako0v0v.itch.io/the-dragons-equation]itch.io[/url]]
